snippet.title: Play the Demo NOW | The Whims of the Gods Trailer
snippet.description:
🌋 Add The Whims of the Gods to your wishlist NOW! ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642390/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer

The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.

🏠  Coming to Steam Early Access in Q3 2025!
